Yes, **Provita** (such as [Provita Nutrition & Health](https://provita-nutrition.ca/)) is marketed as a line of natural health supplements and wellness products. The brand focuses on evidence-based natural ingredients, plant extracts, vitamins, and probiotics designed to support the body's natural functions. [](https://ca.linkedin.com/company/provita-nutrition)

- **Natural Formulations:** Utilizes plant extracts, herbs, and natural precursors to support wellness.

- **Science-Backed:** Combines traditional naturopathic elements with modern nutritional research.

- **Product Types:** Includes immune support, probiotics, and general dietary supplements. [](https://provita-nutrition.ca/)
